parts.label: (i)
parts.text: A random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(42)$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use an appropriate approximating distribution to find $\text{P}(X \geqslant 40)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Justify your use of the approximating distribution.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: A random variable $Y$ has the distribution $\text{B}(60, 0.02)$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use an appropriate approximating distribution to find $\text{P}(Y > 2)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Justify your use of the approximating distribution.
